Frequently asked questions

How do I book a massage at my villa or hotel?

Send us a WhatsApp message with your villa or hotel name (or a Google Maps pin), your preferred time, and the treatment you'd like. We confirm your therapist and arrival time, usually within about 5 minutes.

What does the therapist bring?

Fresh linens, towels, and natural oils. There's no massage table, so you'll need a bed or a quiet corner of your villa.

How and when do I pay?

After your massage, in cash or by bank transfer. There's no upfront deposit for villas and hotels.

Can two of us have a massage at the same time?

Yes, with the Couple Massage: two therapists come, one for each of you. It's IDR 480k for 60 minutes for the two of you.

Can you come to my hotel room?

Yes. Most hotels in Bali allow in-room massage. Tell reception you're expecting a massage therapist so they can send them straight up.

What are your opening hours?

Every day from 08:30 to 23:00, including weekends and public holidays.

Which areas of Bali do you cover?

Canggu, Pererenan, Seminyak, and Kerobokan. Travel is free within our listed neighborhoods; for villas further out we confirm any small travel fee on WhatsApp before booking.

Can I cancel or change my booking?

We would appreciate a quick message on WhatsApp if you need to cancel or reschedule your booking.
